item.tib: bla sgrub 'dod 'byung rin chen gyi cha lag
item.coloph: zhes kyi bla sgrab 'dod 'byung gi cha lag zur tsam bris pa 'di/ mchog sprul yid bzhin legs grub dang / khyung dbon nyi rgyal rnam gnyis kyis/ bskul phyir rdza sprang mang ga yis/ skyabs gnas bla ma'i gsang sgrub kyi/ cha lag slar yang 'dir gang 'thad/ zur du phyung nas bris pa'o//
